title: Minimum Number of Days to Disconnect Island
summary: Given an m x n binary grid where 1 represents land and 0 represents water, an island is defined as a maximal group of 1's that are connected either horizontally or vertically.
statement: Given an m x n binary grid where 1 represents land and 0 represents water, an island is defined as a maximal group of 1's that are connected either horizontally or vertically. The grid is considered disconnected if there are multiple islands. Each day, you are allowed to change one land cell (1) into a water cell (0). Determine the minimum number of days required to disconnect the grid.
constraints: Land uses four-directional connectivity; the grid is disconnected unless it contains exactly one island.
Each day removes one land cell; return the minimum days needed.
hints: First count islands; anything other than exactly one is already disconnected.
Temporarily remove each land cell and recount, restoring it afterward.
Return one if any removal disconnects; otherwise return two.
A connected grid always becomes disconnected after at most two removals, so these exhaustive cases are sufficient.
editorial: A connected grid always becomes disconnected after at most two removals, so these exhaustive cases are sufficient.

tests.explanation: No single cell disconnects the two-by-two island, but removing two cells does.
Removing either cell leaves one island, while removing both leaves zero islands, so two days are required.
